tools.name: readScriptSource
tools.description: Read the actual source code of a SuiteScript file in this NetSuite account so it can be reviewed for logic and mistakes. Provide a scriptId (custom script id like 'customscript_pc_foo', the numeric internal id as a string, or the exact script name), OR a direct File Cabinet fileId, OR a filePath. Returns the source as plain text with optional 1-based line-range paging for large or minified files. Read-only; never modifies anything.

scriptId.description: Script identifier: custom script id (e.g. 'customscript_pc_foo'), numeric internal id as a string, or the exact script name.

fileId.description: Direct File Cabinet internal id of the script .js file. Takes precedence over scriptId and filePath.

filePath.description: Full File Cabinet path to the .js file, e.g. '/SuiteScripts/PowerCloud/foo.js'. Used when fileId is not supplied.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Default 2000. Use with startLine to page through large files.

truncated.description: True when fewer than totalLines were returned.

error.description: Empty on success; a human-readable message on failure.

tools.name: listScripts
tools.description: List SuiteScript records in this NetSuite account with metadata only (no source code), to discover what scripts exist before reading one. Optionally filter by name/id substring and by script type. Returns a JSON-string array in 'scriptsJson'. Read-only.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against script name or custom script id.

scriptType.description: Filter by script type code, e.g. 'USEREVENT', 'CLIENT', 'SCHEDULED', 'MAPREDUCE', 'SUITELET', 'RESTLET', 'WORKFLOWACTION', 'MASSUPDATE', 'PORTLET', 'BUNDLEINSTALLATION'.

includeInactive.description: Include inactive scripts. Default false (active only).

scriptsJson.description: JSON-encoded array of { scriptName, scriptId, scriptType, fileId, fileName, isInactive }.

capped.description: True when more rows existed than were returned (limit 200).

tools.name: readFile
tools.description: Read the contents of any text file in the File Cabinet (e.g. XML, JSON, CSV, FreeMarker, HTML, CSS, plain text), not just scripts. Provide a fileId or a filePath. Binary files (images, PDFs, archives) are refused rather than returned as base64. Supports 1-based line-range paging. Read-only.

fileId.description: File Cabinet internal id. Takes precedence over filePath.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Default 2000.

isBinary.description: True when the file type is binary and was not read.

tools.name: getScriptDeployments
tools.description: Return the deployment records for a script, showing how and when it actually runs: status, deployed flag, execution context, record type, and log level. Provide a scriptId (custom id, numeric internal id as string, or name) or a numeric scriptInternalId. Returns a JSON-string array in 'deploymentsJson'. Read-only.

scriptId.description: Custom script id, numeric internal id as a string, or exact script name.

scriptInternalId.description: Numeric internal id of the script record.

deploymentsJson.description: JSON-encoded array of { deploymentId, scriptName, status, isDeployed, executionContext, recordType, logLevel }.

tools.name: getAccountInfo
tools.description: Return this NetSuite account's own identity and platform facts: account id, environment type (production/sandbox), NetSuite release version, whether the NetSuite Next runtime API (N/runtime.isNextActive) exists, and, when the role permits, Company Information fields (companyid, company name, legal name, country). Use this first to confirm which account and release you are working against. Read-only; takes no input.

accountId.description: The account id from N/runtime (e.g. '5641465', '1234567_SB1'). Authoritative.

version.description: NetSuite release the account runs, e.g. '2026.2'.

roleId.description: Internal id of the executing role (diagnostics).

nextApiAvailable.description: True when N/runtime.isNextActive exists (NetSuite Next-era release).

isNextActiveForThisRole.description: Result of isNextActive() for the executing user, when callable.

companyId.description: Company Information ACCOUNT ID field, when readable; cross-check against accountId.

companyInfoSource.description: 'config' when Company Information was read; otherwise an explanation.

error.description: Empty on success; a human-readable message on failure.
